summary: Tested Document Type Classification (Phase 2). features_verified: 1. classify_document() returns simple_receipt for informal/handwritten receipts (few lines, low density)
2. classify_document() returns structured_invoice for formal columnar invoices (many lines, table lines)
4. classify_document() returns multi_page_pdf for PDF files with page_count > 1
5. classify_document() returns structured_invoice for single-page PDFs (layout-based)
6. get_parser_route() maps each document_type to correct parser route string
7. Classification result includes document_type, page_count, file_format, vendor_pattern, confidence_reason, layout_features
8. Layout analysis extracts: width, height, aspect_ratio, text_density, horizontal_line_ratio, content_fill, estimated_line_count
9. POST /api/upload/extract response includes document_classification and parser_route fields
10. Classification is stored in uploaded_receipts collection (document_classification, parser_route)
11. Classification does not change any extraction behavior (same items, same validation)
12. classify_document() gracefully handles empty images list (returns structured_invoice fallback)
13. classify_document() gracefully handles invalid base64 data (returns structured_invoice with empty layout_features)
